race_level_duplicate_matching.description: race_is_duplicate() (old app) considers a candidate a duplicate of an existing race in the SAME competition only if total_time_ms, lane, opponent, laps_csv, and dnf ALL match exactly. It does not consider distance_m at all beyond what's implied by matching within a competition+distance context. Two races on the same day at the same distance with different opponents/lanes are correctly treated as distinct (e.g. two heats), but two independently-typo'd imports with an empty lane/opponent and identical time/laps are silently merged.
